name: Ripple USD
oneLiner: RLUSD is Ripple's NYDFS-chartered dollar stablecoin redeemable 1:1 and backed by USD deposits, cash equivalents, and short-term U.S. Treasuries.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits, cash equivalents, and short-term U.S. government Treasuries held in segregated accounts

applicabilityBasis.summary: RLUSD is a U.S. dollar payment stablecoin issued through Ripple's NYDFS-chartered subsidiary with 1:1 redemption and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.licensingRegulator: NYDFS (current issuer charter); OCC conditional national trust bank charter pending (Ripple National Trust Bank)
genius.notes: RLUSD is issued by Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC (SCTC), a NYDFS-chartered limited purpose trust company. Ripple also received a conditional OCC approval (December 12, 2025) to establish Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB) as a de novo national trust bank to manage RLUSD reserves — this is an OCC trust bank charter under existing authority, not a GENIUS Act PPSI approval. Ripple's stated GENIUS compliance pathway is NYDFS state equivalency (SCTC). No PPSI application or approval exists as of 2026-06-18; the GENIUS Act rulemaking remains at the NPRM stage.

mintAuthority.summary: RLUSD Ethereum minting is gated by Ripple's custom 2-of-31 MultiSign minter. The proxy creation calldata and current role reads identify separate 7-of-12 Ripple MultiSign contracts for DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and UPGRADER_ROLE. The XRPL issuer account has its master key active and no signer list.

controls.label: RLUSD Ethereum minter - Ripple MultiSign contract (2-of-31)
controls.evidence: RLUSD ETH (0x8292) is a StablecoinProxy (UUPS), implementation StablecoinUpgradeableV2 at 0x9747a0d261c2d56eb93f542068e5d1e23170fa9e. hasRole(MINTER_ROLE, 0x97e9) = true (MINTER_ROLE bytes32 obtained via MINTER_ROLE() getter 0xd5391393). Contract 0x97e9 verified on Blockscout as Ripple's MultiSign (EIP-712 multisig): signers() returns 31 addresses, quorum() = 2, each signerWeight = 1, nonce = 350. No GnosisSafe module structure — custom Ripple EIP-712 multisig.

controls.label: RLUSD XRPL issuer account (Ripple master key)
controls.evidence: XRPL account_info for rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De: Flags = 0x819a0000 (RequireDestTag, DisallowXRP, DefaultRipple, DepositAuth SET; NoFreeze NOT set; GlobalFreeze NOT set). RegularKey = none. No signer_list present. Master key active; XRPL issuance fully controlled by Ripple. Total XRPL RLUSD obligations = 761,696,376 RLUSD.

controls.label: RLUSD Ethereum role-admin MultiSign (7-of-12)
controls.evidence: RLUSD proxy initialization calldata assigns DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to 0x66fc. At block 25530195, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0x66fc) returned true; the verified Ripple MultiSign reports quorum 7 and 12 signers. This role can grant and revoke mint-critical roles.

controls.label: RLUSD Ethereum upgrader MultiSign (7-of-12)
controls.evidence: RLUSD proxy initialization calldata assigns UPGRADER_ROLE to 0x863c. At block 25530195, hasRole(UPGRADER_ROLE, 0x863c) returned true; the verified Ripple MultiSign reports quorum 7 and the same 12-signer set as the role-admin MultiSign.

review.evidence: ETH: MINTER_ROLE holder is 0x97e9 (Ripple MultiSign, quorum 2 of 31). The proxy creation calldata names 0x66fc as DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and 0x863c as UPGRADER_ROLE; current hasRole reads at block 25530195 confirm both assignments, and both verified MultiSign contracts report quorum 7 of 12. XRPL: issuer rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De has its master key active and no signer list.

reserveReview.rationale: Deloitte's May examination reports $1.162351093 billion of Treasury bills, $345.319216 million of government money market funds, and $269.247197 million of cash deposits at May 29, 2026. Excluding the separately disclosed negative $3.915600 million timing adjustment, gross reserve assets normalize to 65.41%, 19.44%, and 15.15%, respectively; the registry retains their aggregate live-feed identity for deterministic reconciliation. The CUSIP-level table shows the longest Treasury bill maturing August 6, 2026 (69 days after the report date), and the examined NYDFS DFS-imposed Conditions plus the RLUSD User Terms restrict Treasury bills to three months or less from maturity; the registry records the 92-day covenant bound (maximum three-calendar-month span) as maturityDaysMax. Composition re-verified against the same May 2026 report on 2026-07-19; percentages unchanged.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Deloitte examination of the RLUSD Reserve Report as of May 29, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No material asset-class exposure is unclassified; the public report does not identify the depository institutions, money market funds, or custodians.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Ripple's July 9, 2025 press release names BNY as the primary RLUSD reserve custodian, and the Deloitte report plus stablecoin terms confirm segregated reserve accounts held with NYDFS-approved U.S. depositories or custodians. Custody allocation shares, the identities of any additional depository institutions, statutory bankruptcy remoteness, and reserve-wide rehypothecation treatment remain undisclosed.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: RLUSD is issued by Ripple on Ethereum and XRPL as issuer-native stablecoin deployments, not as a holder-facing third-party bridge wrapper. Cross-chain route risk is therefore reviewed as issuer-native mint/redeem exposure.
